approach_summary: Establish a trustworthy ROC-AUC baseline before any feature engineering or ensembling. Strong univariate signal (cloud +0.64, sunshine -0.56, humidity +0.45) plus a seasonal `day` feature make LightGBM a natural first fit. Use 5-fold stratified CV (classes are 75/25, not perfectly balanced) scored on ROC-AUC. Drop `id` (row index, ~0 correlation).

Establish a verified gradient boosting baseline using XGBoost after exp_001 encountered an error. Evaluate using 5-fold StratifiedKFold cross-validation target-indexed on ROC-AUC, dropping the identifier column `id`.

Establish a valid baseline CV score using scikit-learn's native HistGradientBoostingClassifier following execution errors in exp_001 and exp_002. Evaluated via 5-fold StratifiedKFold on ROC-AUC with 'id' dropped.

Establish a robust baseline using CatBoostClassifier evaluated via 5-fold StratifiedKFold cross-validation on ROC-AUC score after previous execution issues on exp_001-exp_003. Drop the identifier column 'id'.

Previous gradient boosting runs (exp_001 to exp_004) encountered execution errors. Using scikit-learn's native RandomForestClassifier provides a reliable, non-linear baseline to establish a validated CV ROC-AUC benchmark.
